# Haseeb Asad

> Software engineer at Oasys (https://oasys.health) and founder of Codex Labs (https://www.codex-labs.dev), a studio for automation, AI agents, web, mobile and macOS apps.

## About

- Current role: software engineer at Oasys, software for therapy group practices.
- Previous roles: AI-First Software Engineer II at Khoros (IgniteTech); Lead Engineer at Glow; Software Engineer II at Bazaar.
- Stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, GraphQL, React Native, n8n.
- Client work is handled through Codex Labs. To hire him for a project, use https://www.codex-labs.dev/get-started or email support@codex-labs.dev.
- Personal email: haseebasad305@gmail.com

## Projects

- [Synopt](https://synopt.dev): AI coding observability for engineering teams using Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, with an open source, self-hosted agent.
- [Taperlark](https://taperlark.com): native macOS apps (CoolCurve, Preen, Submix).
- [BookWithKhelo](https://bookwithkhelo.com): sports venue booking in Pakistan.
- [openwhenitstime.com](https://openwhenitstime.com): time-locked letters that open on a chosen date.
